incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: Pixebot Browser opened, but the local Pixebot Core backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart Pixebot Browser.

incompleteInstallation.title: Pixebot Browser installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so Pixebot Core cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest Pixebot Browser. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined Pixebot Core.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest Pixebot Browser package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined Pixebot Browser components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: Pixebot Browser package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This Pixebot Browser package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: Pixebot Browser opened, but Pixebot Core stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling Pixebot Browser may not fix this. Please restart the app. If it keeps happening, the local database migration may need to be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of Pixebot Browser is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of Pixebot Browser, and this version can't open it. Update Pixebot Browser to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of Pixebot Browser newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update Pixebot Browser to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: Pixebot Browser opened, but Pixebot Core stopped while preparing local startup data such as Agent or engine records. Reinstalling Pixebot Browser may not fix this. Please restart the app. If it keeps happening, the local database may need to be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: Pixebot Browser opened, but Pixebot Core could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart Pixebot Browser.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: Pixebot Browser detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, Pixebot Browser will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: Pixebot Browser is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another Pixebot Browser startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart Pixebot Browser.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: Pixebot Core is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: Pixebot Core couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app. If it keeps happening, check that the Pixebot Core backend is installed.

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: Pixebot Core didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app. If it keeps happening, check that the Pixebot Core backend is installed.

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: Pixebot Core failed to start. Please restart the app. If it keeps happening, check that the Pixebot Core backend is installed.
